Container.Name: ph-intercept
Container.Overview:
Real-time DNS dashboard for Pi-hole v6, AdGuard Home, and Technitium DNS. Every query becomes a ship on screen: allowed queries fly past as friendlies, and blocked ones get shot down by an interceptor. The HUD shows live stats and lets you pause blocking with a timer.
Setup: pick your PROVIDER, then fill in the URL and credentials for that provider only. Leave the other providers' fields blank. - Pi-hole: API URL like http://192.168.1.x:80/api and an app password (Pi-hole Settings, Web interface / API, Configure app password). - AdGuard Home: control URL like http://192.168.1.x:3000/control plus username and password. - Technitium: web console URL like http://192.168.1.x:5380 plus an API token. Install the Query Logs (Sqlite) app in Technitium so ships spawn.
Optional settings (backgrounds, ignored domains and clients, view-only and privacy options for shared screens, 2-player split screen with a second DNS server) are under Show more settings.
Container.Requires: A Pi-hole v6, AdGuard Home, or Technitium DNS server the container can reach over the network.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: pihole pi-hole adguard technitium dns dashboard ad blocker visualizer

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the dashboard. Change it if 4653 is already in use on your server.

Config.Name: DNS provider
Config.Description: Which DNS server to watch. Fill in only that provider's fields below.

Config.Name: Pi-hole: API URL
Config.Description: Pi-hole v6 API base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.x:80/api (v5 is not supported).

Config.Name: Pi-hole: app password
Config.Description: Pi-hole app password, from Settings, Web interface / API, Configure app password.

Config.Name: AdGuard Home: control URL
Config.Description: AdGuard Home control API base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.x:3000/control

Config.Name: AdGuard Home: username
Config.Description: AdGuard Home username or email address.

Config.Name: AdGuard Home: password
Config.Description: AdGuard Home password.

Config.Name: Technitium: console URL
Config.Description: Technitium web console address, e.g. http://192.168.1.x:5380

Config.Name: Technitium: API token
Config.Description: Permanent API token from the Technitium console (recommended). Or leave blank and use the username and password under Show more settings.

Config.Name: Technitium: username
Config.Description: Console username, only if you are not using an API token.

Config.Name: Technitium: password
Config.Description: Console password, only if you are not using an API token.

Config.Name: Technitium: 2FA code
Config.Description: Only if the console account has 2FA enabled. Not needed with an API token.

Config.Name: Technitium: query log app
Config.Description: Installed name of the Technitium query-log app. Change only if you renamed it.

Config.Name: Technitium: query log class
Config.Description: Class path of the Technitium query-log app. Change only if you renamed it.

Config.Name: Default background
Config.Description: Starting background. Viewers can switch it live in the app.

Config.Name: Sky region
Config.Description: Constellations shown in the starfield background.

Config.Name: Custom background image
Config.Description: Image URL, or /bg/your-file.jpg for a file in the backgrounds folder below. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: Backgrounds folder
Config.Description: Folder for custom background images, used with the Custom background image setting.

Config.Name: ESC return URL
Config.Description: Where pressing ESC takes you, e.g. your homelab dashboard. Leave blank to disable ESC.

Config.Name: View-only mode
Config.Description: Set to true for a wall display or a page others can open: the server refuses the blocking toggle, filter updates, and 2-player mode changes, and the HUD leaves those controls inert. Stats stay visible.

Config.Name: Hide client names
Config.Description: Set to true to drop the client name or IP from every query before it reaches the browser. The in-app CLIENT toggle is hidden.

Config.Name: Hide domains
Config.Description: Set to true to replace every domain with an opaque token before it reaches the browser (new random key at each start). Repeat queries still group; domain labels and the DOMAIN toggle are left out.

Config.Name: Pi-hole: verify SSL
Config.Description: Set to false if Pi-hole uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

Config.Name: AdGuard Home: verify SSL
Config.Description: Set to false if AdGuard Home uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

Config.Name: Technitium: verify SSL
Config.Description: Set to false if Technitium uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

Config.Name: Pi-hole: ignored domains
Config.Description: Comma-separated regex patterns; matching domains spawn no ships. Example: .*\.local$,.*\.internal$

Config.Name: Pi-hole: ignored clients
Config.Description: Comma-separated regex patterns matched against the client name and IP; queries from matching clients spawn no ships. Example: ^uptime-kuma$,^10\.0\.0\.5$

Config.Name: AdGuard Home: ignored domains
Config.Description: Comma-separated regex patterns; matching domains spawn no ships. Example: .*\.local$,.*\.internal$

Config.Name: AdGuard Home: ignored clients
Config.Description: Comma-separated regex patterns matched against the client name and IP; queries from matching clients spawn no ships. Example: ^uptime-kuma$,^10\.0\.0\.5$

Config.Name: Technitium: ignored domains
Config.Description: Comma-separated regex patterns; matching domains spawn no ships. Example: .*\.local$,.*\.internal$

Config.Name: Technitium: ignored clients
Config.Description: Comma-separated regex patterns matched against the client IP (Technitium logs no client name); queries from matching clients spawn no ships. Example: ^192\.168\.1\.99$

Config.Name: 2-player: second Pi-hole URL
Config.Description: Second Pi-hole v6 API URL for split-screen 2-player mode. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: 2-player: second Pi-hole password
Config.Description: App password for the second Pi-hole, if it has one.

Config.Name: 2-player: second Pi-hole verify SSL
Config.Description: Set to false if the second Pi-hole uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

Config.Name: 2-player: second AdGuard URL
Config.Description: Second AdGuard Home control URL for split-screen 2-player mode. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: 2-player: second AdGuard username
Config.Description: Username for the second AdGuard Home.

Config.Name: 2-player: second AdGuard password
Config.Description: Password for the second AdGuard Home.

Config.Name: 2-player: second AdGuard verify SSL
Config.Description: Set to false if the second AdGuard Home uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

Config.Name: 2-player: second Technitium URL
Config.Description: Second Technitium console URL for split-screen 2-player mode. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: 2-player: second Technitium token
Config.Description: API token for the second Technitium server (recommended).

Config.Name: 2-player: second Technitium username
Config.Description: Console username for the second Technitium server, only if you are not using an API token.

Config.Name: 2-player: second Technitium password
Config.Description: Console password for the second Technitium server, only if you are not using an API token.

Config.Name: 2-player: second Technitium 2FA code
Config.Description: Only if the second server's console account has 2FA enabled. Not needed with an API token.

Config.Name: 2-player: second Technitium verify SSL
Config.Description: Set to false if the second Technitium server uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.
